notes: Ask the zoo if applications are open: 816-595-1234.
name: VolunTEEN
what_you_do: It is a teen volunteer program all year. In year 1, teens start as a Trailblazer or DigiTEEN. Then they pick a path. The paths are Junior Interpreter, Junior Counselor, EnviroTeen, Junior Caretaker and Teen Advisory Council.
who_can_apply: Students in 8th to 12th grade at the time of application. Seniors can join for the summer season only. Mature, responsible teens who like working with the public and care about animals.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Trailblazers need 60 hours in summer and 18 hours each in fall and spring.
duration: May through April. Three seasons: summer, fall, spring.
deadline_text: Pages disagree. The zoo page has an Apply Today link but no dates. The linked posting shows a Feb 28 deadline with no year and 0 openings.
how_to_apply: Apply online for a pathway when applications open. See the zoo's VolunTEEN page.
